rows.definition: The GGUF 'attn_v' value-projection weight (maps hidden state to the per-KV-head value vectors of a self-attention layer), canonicalized to self_attn.v_proj.weight on load.
rows.distinction: It is the dense value projection, NOT the query projection attn_q and NOT the key projection attn_k.

rows.definition: The IO-aware fused attention kernel technique (Dao et al.) that computes exact softmax attention via tiling and online softmax without materializing the full N-by-N score matrix, referenced as the SOTA ladder rung fak's own fused online-softmax kernel targets.
rows.distinction: It is the KERNEL TECHNIQUE concept (IO-aware tiling + online softmax), NOT the fak capability bit (FusedAttn) that advertises a backend can lower to it and NOT the vLLM paged-KV scheme (PagedAttention).

rows.definition: The GLM-MoE-DSA sparse-attention sublayer for one decode position (internal/model/glm_dsa_session.go): runs DSA key selection, sparse QK scoring, and value gathering for a single cached step, distinct from the cacheless prefill path.
rows.distinction: It is the DSA-specific per-position decode step, NOT the dense cached single-step sublayer (attnBody) and NOT the cacheless whole-sequence dense body (attnSeq).

rows.definition: The Session.Prefill/Step twin of linearAttnSeq (internal/model/qwen35.go): consumes one already-normalized input position and advances the Gated-DeltaNet recurrent linear-attention state by one step on the cached decode path.
rows.distinction: It is the per-position decode step, NOT the whole-sequence scan (linearAttnSeq) and NOT the linear-attention layer concept/predicate (linear attention).

rows.definition: watchdoghealth.Health.NeedsAttention() and Digest.NeedsAttention - the one-bit operations gate (true when any monitor sits at or above the attention floor: DOWN, UNKNOWN, or GAVE_UP) a supervisor loop or CI keys on without re-scanning every monitor row.
rows.distinction: An OPERATIONS health-attention gate (does a monitor need a human?), NOT the ML softmax token-mixer (Attention) and NOT the taskgraph/toolproc AttentionNeeded rollup bits despite sharing the 'attention' word.

rows.definition: A one-line readout function (in gardenbundle, watchdoghealth, and releasestatus) that renders the decenter split - which attention-floor monitors wait on a human vs which the fleet can clear - as a single digest line.
rows.distinction: An OPERATIONS triage rendering function (splits human vs fleet work), NOT the ML softmax token-mixer (Attention) despite sharing the 'attention' word; the same function name appears in three packages for three different domain types (WalkPlan, Digest, Status).

rows.definition: watchdoghealth.PartitionAttention - splits the digest's attention-floor monitors into two buckets: those whose remedy needs a human (needHuman) and those the fleet can clear on its own (fleetClears), reserving ALERT severity for the genuine human residual.
rows.distinction: An OPERATIONS decenter-split function (partitions human vs fleet work), NOT the ML softmax token-mixer (Attention) and NOT the attention-witness accumulator (AttentionAccumulator) despite sharing the 'attention' word.
